impact_scope.description: Introduces a public experimental meshlet-optimization entry point with a caller-supplied level parameter in the range [0, 9].

evidence: S0 has no matching declaration or implementation of meshopt_optimizeMeshletLevel, so this exact API had no harness-exposure obligation.
S1 declares and implements meshopt_optimizeMeshletLevel as a new public experimental function.
H0 does not call meshopt_optimizeMeshletLevel or supply its level argument; its meshlet-building calls do not automatically reach this optimizer.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 must add a call to meshopt_optimizeMeshletLevel with valid meshlet vertex/triangle buffers and fuzz-controlled or otherwise varied level values in [0, 9].
evidence: The new function requires a direct entry call and a caller-supplied level parameter that were unnecessary in S0.
The unchanged legacy meshopt_optimizeMeshlet wrapper always passes level 0, so it does not expose the new nonzero-level behavior.

reason: The anchored callable is absent in S0 and newly public in S1, making GapBefore false. H0 does not invoke it or control its new level input, making GapAfter true. This is a concrete new caller-visible harness obligation, so the delta is NEW and maintenance is needed.
